name: aishield-mcp
description: AIShield security scanner as an MCP server: scan MCP servers, AI skills and agents for poisoning, injection, leakage, and supply-chain risk (OWASP MCP Top 10 + OWASP Agentic AI Top 10).

tools.name: aishield_scan
tools.description: Full security scan of an MCP server / AI skill / agent (GitHub URL). Returns 5-dimension score + OWASP coverage + findings.

tools.name: aishield_guardrail
tools.description: Pre-install gate: pass/block verdict before installing any third-party MCP server.

tools.name: aishield_prompt_check
tools.description: Detect prompt injection / jailbreak / data-exfiltration in user prompts (zh + en).

tools.name: aishield_rug_pull
tools.description: Detect rug-pull: security-code removal or suspicious additions across recent commits.

tools.name: aishield_handshake
tools.description: MCP handshake verification: npx auto-install risk, sensitive env vars, oversized tool descriptions.

tools.name: aishield_digest
tools.description: Compact trust digest: a few hundred bytes + a content fingerprint, so an agent can answer 'can I trust this?' every turn without re-pulling the full report.

trust.standard: OWASP MCP Top 10 (2025 v0.1) + OWASP Agentic AI Top 10
trust.verification: self-attested, open-source — no third-party audit claimed

category_id_note: The owasp_category values ASI01-ASI10 are AIShield's INTERNAL category IDs, not the official OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications (2026) identifiers. Only ASI01/ASI02/ASI03 coincide. Internal ASI04 (memory poisoning) = official ASI06 Memory & Context Poisoning; official ASI04 = Agentic Supply Chain. Internal ASI09 (cascading failure) = official ASI08. Official ASI05 (Unexpected Code Execution) has no dedicated internal category. The field carries TWO namespaces: MCP01-MCP10 are official OWASP MCP Top 10 codes; ASI01-ASI10 are AIShield internal. Most Agentic scanners emit MCP0x - of the 11 Agentic modules only scanner/memory_integrity_scan.py emits an internal ASI code (ASI04) - so filtering reports on ASI0x misses the majority of Agentic findings. Machine-readable crosswalk: the internal_to_owasp_agentic key returned by compliance_summary(). Source of truth: scanner/compliance.py (INTERNAL_ASI_TO_OWASP, OWASP_AGENTIC_2026, OWASP_AGENTIC_THREATS T1-T17).
